name: Monochrome Wizard ~Kuro no Sanka, Shiro no Chinkonka~
original_name: Monochrome Wizard～黒の讃歌、白の鎮魂歌～
source:
A pretty doll-like girl was begrudgingly awaiting her graduation.
Due to monetary reasons, she wouldn't be able to continue her studies,
and didn't have any job prospects either.

With little hope for the future, she ran into the forest one day while escaping bullies.
She found a mysterious dungeon and with nowhere to hide, she decided to step in...
On the other side of the dungeon was a completely different world.

Suddenly, military-looking men approached her.
They thought that she might be a suspicious person and had been watching her...

Walk together with them, or get tangled in jealousy---
An isekai trip where you recover your "pain".

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE260241.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一名漂亮得像人偶的女孩，勉強等待著畢業。由於經濟原因，她無法繼續學業，也沒有任何就業前景。

某天，為了躲避霸凌，她帶著對未來所剩無幾的希望逃進森林。在那裡，她發現一座神秘地牢；無處可躲的她決定走進去……地牢另一側，是一個完全不同的世界。

突然，幾名看起來像軍人的男人向她走來。他們認為她是可疑人物，一直在監視她……

與他們同行，還是被嫉妒糾纏——一場找回「痛苦」的異世界之旅。

[來源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE260241.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
